scope: Final native-v2 evidence assembly; four fixed browser/order cells remain separate. No runtime edits, new measurements, retries, tail exclusions or pooling.

originalZipContainers.reason: Every original regular-file payload is retained byte-for-byte under its browser/order prefix. Original ZIP container hashes, lengths and member mappings are retained; container metadata is not reconstructed. No original ZIP is modified or downloaded again.

extractedDuplicates.reason: Separate analysis/extraction copies duplicate original ZIP payloads. Their verification receipts are retained in browser provenance.

caches.reason: Reproducible interpreter caches are not measurement evidence.

failedV1.reason: Preserved separately with all failed-before-import evidence; its identity/coverage/packing receipts are included here without duplicating or modifying that archive. V1 produced zero performance observations.

packagingErratum.reason: Original frozen native notes and receipts contained a WASM-only package declaration. The separate erratum corrects that claim while preserving those originals unchanged.

externalReproducibleInputs.reason: Pinned source/fixture/runtime/package identities, observed verification receipts, toolchain metadata and the exact candidate bundle are retained. Reproducible installations and large runtime archives are not duplicated.

priorValidationChecksumStudy.reason: The previous independently preserved study remains separate. The compression source snapshot includes the exact fixture manifest needed for offline classification; no generated checksum store image is required or included here.

mutableOperationalState.reason: Publication payloads, transfer URLs and mutable orchestration state are outside the frozen evidence selection. Safe artifact/job metadata and all browser audit/acquisition receipts are retained.

postAssemblyOutputs.reason: Final documentation, packing/coverage receipts and later publication CI remain alongside the archive to avoid self-referential hash cycles. Root analysis and its assembly-attempt receipt are included before packing.

redactions.policy: A new credential-pattern finding stops assembly for review; no original payload is silently redacted or omitted.
